newsitem.title: USA: General Housewares repeats Q2 break even outlook.
newsitem.headline: General Housewares repeats Q2 break even outlook.

text.p: General Housewares Corp Tuesday reiterated its forecast for a breakeven second quarter, compared to a loss of $0.37 a share a year ago.
"Based on current orders and shipment projections, we believe that the second quarter results will approximate our operating plan at break even," chief executive officer Paul Saxton said.

Earlier Tuesday, the cooking items company reported a net loss of $694,000 or $0.18 a share for the quarter, as compared to a net loss of $2.2 million, or $0.59 per share in the first quarter of 1996. First quarter of 1996 results included sales and operating losses of the Sidney division as well as restructuring costs, and various charges, associated with its later disposition, the company said.
"Slow reorder rates from certain key accounts and low traffic at our outlet stores resulted in a somewhat greater loss than we anticipated," Saxton said.
General Housewares shares closed up 1/8 at 8-3/4 Tuesday.
